card.name: Mid-sentence slots before a comparison or caveat
card.fires_on: Marked words at points in a drug-label sentence where a comparison or qualifier is about to follow, such as the start of the word placebo, a drug name, a verb after a drug subject, or a comma before a contrast.

modes.label: Inside placebo or drug names
modes.description: Early pieces of 'placebo' or a brand or generic drug name just before 'compared to placebo' or similar.

modes.label: Verb after a drug subject
modes.description: A form of 'is' or 'were' right after a drug or study subject, before a condition or result.

modes.description: A comma after a concession clause, before the opposing clause.
